nuggets.text: The Eagles earned the 500th win in program history by beating Sacramento State 28-17 in this season's opener.
Noah Kim, who began his college career at Michigan State in 2020, returns to Spartan Stadium as the Eagles' starting quarterback.
Noah Kim is playing his seventh year of college football after the NCAA granted him an extra year of eligibility.
The Eagles have a returning starting quarterback for the first time since 2017, when Brogan Roback held the job.
The Eagles play on gray FieldTurf at Rynearson Stadium, a surface installed in 2014.
The Eagles were known as the Hurons from 1956 to 1990, switching to their current name in May 1991.
The Eagles won their first bowl game in 1987, upsetting San Jose State in the California Bowl in Fresno.
Noah Kim led the MAC with 2,817 passing yards in 2025, starting all 12 games in his first season with the Eagles.
Chris Creighton is in his 13th season as the Eagles' head coach.
Zach Mowchan piled up 14 tackles, two for loss, in the Eagles' season-opening win over Sacramento State.
